text:
Noah: hi team! first day and i'm stuck. okta rejects me with 'unrecognized account' even though i used the invite link. also 1Password invite went to my personal mailbox by mistake. who do i bug?

Rina (IT): welcome Noah :wave: can you paste the exact Okta error or screenshot? Which email did you use to sign in?

Noah: tried noah@redwood.dev and noah.hires@redwood.dev (the invite used the latter). Okta shows 'We couldn't find an account for that email'. invite link looks like it was created for the alias.

it-ops-bot: Ticket ONB-5120 opened for okta-alias-provisioning:2756123456. Assigned to Rina (IT).

Rina (IT): ah, looks like People Ops created the account under the recruiting alias and we didn't merge aliases yet. Asha, can you confirm the canonical email?

Asha (People Ops): confirmed canonical is noah@redwood.dev. we accidentally created the onboarding invite with noah.hires@contractor-mail.com. i'll re-provision and add an alias mapping.

1Password-bot: 1Password invite sent to noah.hires@contractor-mail.com.

Noah: that's the one in spam. i accepted it but it made a vault tied to the wrong identity and i can't join the company vaults.

Kyle (Security): two quick items: 1) we need the Okta account under canonical email to attach device certs, 2) if 1Password seat is consumed under the wrong email we'll reclaim and reassign. Rina, you can revoke the deviate invite after we create the correct account.

Rina (IT): creating noah@redwood.dev now, adding alias noah.hires@contractor-mail.com, reissuing Okta invite and resending 1Password invite. Noah - when you get the 1Password email again, accept and open the link from the same browser where you log into Okta (to avoid session mismatch).

it-ops-bot: ONB-5120 updated: account re-created, alias mapped, reissued invites. ETA 20m.

Noah: got the Okta invite for noah@redwood.dev, followed it and it asked me to register a security key for MFA but i don't have the hardware key yet. it gives no fallback to TOTP.

Kyle (Security): sorry about that. For new hires we've started rolling out hardware-key first policy, but we should allow temporary TOTP until keys ship. Rina, enabling temporary exception for Noah to allow Okta Verify (TOTP) for 24h.

Rina (IT): exception applied. Noah, try signing in again and choose Okta Verify -> set up with the authenticator app.

Noah: signed in, set up Okta Verify, MFA succeeded. 1Password invite arrived for noah@redwood.dev and i accepted and now i see the company vault.

Asha (People Ops): confirmed I reclaimed the misrouted 1Password seat and freed the contractor email. Also updated the new-hire checklist to prevent alias invites.

Rina (IT): closing ONB-5120: resolved by alias mapping + temporary TOTP exception + reclaim/reassign 1Password seat. Folks, note: if you see "unrecognized account" for new hires, check alias vs canonical email first.

Noah: amazing, thanks so much everyone! excited to start. ping me for repo access if available. :grinning:
